title: Teriyaki Chicken
description: Crisp-skinned boneless chicken legs glazed in a glossy homemade sake, mirin and soy teriyaki that reduces right in the pan. Far better than bottled, and done in half an hour.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce.
watch: Check mirin labels (pure rice mirin is fine).

title: Thai Salmon Coconut Curry
description: Seared salmon fillets nestled into a fragrant green curry with coconut milk, green beans and Japanese eggplant, finished with Thai basil.
swaps: Use a shellfish-free curry paste (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many restaurant-style pastes contain shrimp paste.
watch: Green curry paste: confirm no shrimp paste. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Chicken Curry (Indian Style)
description: A home-style North Indian chicken curry: bone-in chicken simmered in an onion-tomato masala with whole spices, garam masala and fresh coriander.
swaps: Skip the yogurt (and the cashew alternative); use the recipe's light coconut milk option in place of the hot water for a richer gravy.
watch: Check garam masala/chili powder blends for added wheat fillers.

title: Fish Curry (Indian Fish Masala)
description: Pan-fried firm white fish simmered in a spiced onion-tomato masala with curry leaves and fennel, enriched with coconut.
swaps: Use the coconut option (grated coconut or coconut milk), not the cashews.

title: Rajma Masala (Kidney Bean Curry)
description: Punjabi-style kidney beans pressure-cooked until creamy, then simmered in a gingery tomato-onion gravy with kasuri methi. The classic with rice.
swaps: Replace the 1 Tbsp ghee with oil (ghee is dairy).
watch: Soak the beans overnight; works on the stove or in an Instant Pot.

title: Caribbean Curry Chicken (Bunjay Style)
description: Trinidad-style dry curry: bone-in chicken marinated in green seasoning and lime, then cooked down with toasted curry, geera and Scotch bonnet until the masala clings to every piece.
watch: Check curry powder and anchar masala labels for wheat. Green seasoning is a fresh herb blend (make it or check the jar).

title: Jerk Chicken
description: Bone-in chicken thighs rubbed with jerk seasoning, coconut cream, chilli, thyme, ginger and lime, then roasted or grilled until charred and sticky.
watch: Check jerk seasoning labels for wheat or soy sauce; a dry spice blend is safest. Serve with rice and peas.

title: Ratatouille
description: The Provençal summer stew of aubergine, courgette, peppers and ripe tomatoes, gently cooked in olive oil with garlic and torn basil.

title: Vietnamese Spicy Lemongrass Chicken (Gà Xào Sả Ớt)
description: Bite-size chicken stir-fried with heaps of minced lemongrass, shallot and garlic, then glazed with fish sauce, sambal and coconut juice.
watch: Check sambal oelek and optional chicken bouillon labels for wheat.

title: Cá Kho Tộ (Vietnamese Caramelized Braised Fish)
description: Catfish braised in a clay pot with garlic, fish sauce and coconut juice until the sauce turns into a deep, savory-sweet caramel. Spoon it over plenty of rice.
swaps: Replace the ½ tsp thick (dark) soy sauce with GF tamari or leave it out (it is only there for color).

title: Thai Red Curry Chicken
description: Tender sliced chicken with bell pepper, carrot and broccoli in a creamy red curry coconut sauce brightened with lime, basil and cilantro.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce. Use a shellfish-free curry paste (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many restaurant-style pastes contain shrimp paste.
watch: Check the sweet chili sauce label.

title: Greek Chicken Skewers
description: Lemon-oregano marinated chicken threaded with peppers, zucchini, onion and cherry tomatoes and grilled, souvlaki-style.
swaps: Make the tzatziki with plain unsweetened coconut or soy yogurt (not almond/cashew), or skip it.

title: Moroccan Chicken with Preserved Lemon and Olives
description: A classic Moroccan m'qualli: whole chicken braised with saffron, ginger and a thick golden onion daghmira, finished with preserved lemon and olives. Dinner-party worthy.
swaps: Replace the 1 tsp smen (aged butter) with olive oil.
watch: Recipe starts with a brined chicken; the livers are optional.

title: Moroccan Fish Tagine with Chermoula
description: Thick white fish marinated in cilantro chermoula and slow-cooked in a tagine over layers of potato, carrot, tomato and pepper, crowned with preserved lemon and olives.

title: Easy Chicken Cacciatore
description: Boneless thighs braised in a rustic tomato sauce with peppers, carrot, white wine, thyme and Kalamata olives. Great over GF pasta or polenta.
swaps: Dredge in a gluten-free flour blend; use olive oil instead of butter. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Honey Chipotle Chicken
description: Smoky-sweet chicken marinated in chipotles in adobo, lime and honey, then seared or grilled. Use it for tacos, bowls or straight off the grill.
watch: Chipotles in adobo: some brands contain wheat flour; check the can.

title: Rosemary Chicken with Potatoes and Green Beans
description: Bone-in chicken roasted on one sheet pan with baby red potatoes and green beans, seasoned with rosemary, garlic, paprika and lemon zest.
swaps: Replace the melted butter with olive oil or a nut-free DF butter.

title: Roast Turkey Breast with Gravy
description: A boneless turkey breast rubbed with garlic-herb butter and roasted until juicy, plus a quick pan gravy. Holiday flavor without the whole bird.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free butter (avoid almond/cashew-based brands) or olive oil. Thicken gravy with a GF flour blend or cornstarch; use full-fat coconut milk or skip the cream. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Moroccan-Spiced Sheet Pan Chicken with Ras el Hanout
description: Drumsticks roasted with red onion, carrots and orange slices in a honey, garlic and ras el hanout glaze. Scatter pomegranate on top before serving.
watch: Check the ras el hanout blend label.

title: Coq au Vin with Mashed Potatoes
description: Chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms, onions and herbs, served over mashed potatoes. A French bistro classic that feeds a crowd.
swaps: Use olive oil or nut-free DF butter for the butter; thicken with a GF flour blend. For the mash, use unsweetened soy or coconut milk and DF butter instead of cream and butter. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.
watch: Check bacon labels.

title: Birria de Res (Beef Birria)
description: Chuck or brisket slow-braised in a rich ancho and New Mexican chile sauce with cumin, oregano, cinnamon and clove until it shreds. Serve in corn tortillas with the consommé for dipping.
watch: Use 100% corn tortillas. Chipotles in adobo: check for wheat. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Vegetarian Red Pozole
description: A brick-red ancho and guajillo broth loaded with hominy, piled high with crunchy cabbage, radish, avocado and lime.
watch: Use vegetable stock checked for wheat/dairy; buy corn-only tortilla strips or fry your own.

title: Instant Pot Carnitas
description: Pork shoulder pressure-cooked with orange, lime, garlic and cumin, then shredded and crisped under the broiler. Tacos, bowls or salads.
watch: Serve with 100% corn tortillas.

title: Andalusian Pork Kebabs (Pinchos Morunos)
description: Pork tenderloin cubes marinated in saffron, smoked paprika, cumin, turmeric and lemon, then seared on skewers. A Spanish tapas-bar favorite that also makes a quick dinner.

title: Spanish Garlic Pork Tenderloin (Solomillo al Ajillo)
description: Medallions of pork tenderloin seared in garlic-infused olive oil, then finished in a white wine and thyme garlic sauce. Simple, but it feels like a restaurant plate.
swaps: Use 1 Tbsp gluten-free flour blend (or 2 tsp cornstarch) instead of all-purpose flour. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Spanish Chicken Paella (Paella de Pollo)
description: Valencian-style paella with chicken thighs, flat green beans, butter beans, saffron and rosemary, cooked until a crisp socarrat forms on the bottom.

title: Lamb Mandi (Yemeni Lamb and Rice)
description: Spiced lamb shoulder slow-roasted until it falls off the bone over cardamom-cinnamon basmati, with caramelized onions, raisins and a fresh green chutney.
swaps: Omit the slivered almonds (tree nut); top with toasted pumpkin seeds instead if you want crunch.

title: Slow Cooker Osso Buco
description: Veal shanks browned, then slow-cooked with vermouth, tomatoes and soffritto until meltingly tender, finished with a lemon-parsley gremolata. Serve over polenta.
swaps: Dredge in a gluten-free flour blend; brown in olive oil or nut-free DF butter instead of butter. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Grilled Swordfish with Rosé Wine Mayonnaise
description: Lemony grilled swordfish steaks over a shaved fennel, radish, spinach and avocado salad, with a tangy rosé-shallot mayonnaise on the side.
swaps: Use an egg-free, nut-free vegan mayo (e.g. soy-based) for the mayonnaise.

title: Bulgogi Deopbap (Bulgogi Rice Bowl)
description: Thin-sliced beef in a classic sweet-savory bulgogi marinade with Asian pear, cooked saucy with mushrooms and carrot and spooned over rice.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce.
watch: Use water or vegetable broth (or a fish-only anchovy broth).

title: Jeyuk Bokkeum (Spicy Pork Bulgogi)
description: Thin pork shoulder in a fiery-sweet gochujang, gochugaru, ginger and grated-apple marinade, stir-fried with onion and scallions until caramelized at the edges.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce. Use a certified gluten-free gochujang.
watch: Most gochujang contains wheat or barley; read the label carefully.

title: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Beef
description: Chuck roast cooked low and slow in a tangy BBQ, cider vinegar and smoked paprika sauce, then shredded. Pile it onto GF buns or baked potatoes.
swaps: Use a GF Worcestershire (no malt vinegar) and a GF BBQ sauce. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.
watch: BBQ sauce: avoid malt vinegar and barley malt.

title: Vietnamese Caramelized Lamb Chops
description: Bone-in lamb chops marinated in fish sauce, honey, garlic and shallot, then seared hard so the glaze turns sticky and caramelized.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce. Skip the optional butter or use nut-free DF butter.

title: Lemongrass Salmon Vermicelli Bowl
description: Lemongrass-marinated salmon bites seared and served over rice vermicelli with lettuce, pickled daikon and carrot, cucumber, mint and nuoc cham.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce. Omit the crushed peanuts.
watch: Use 100% rice vermicelli.

title: Sirloin Tip Roast with Gravy
description: An herb-crusted beef round tip roast seared and oven-roasted to rosy medium-rare, with a red wine pan gravy thickened with arrowroot. Already gluten- and dairy-free.
watch: Check broth label.

title: Instant Pot Pulled Pork
description: A big pork shoulder rubbed with smoked paprika, cumin and coconut sugar, pressure-cooked until it shreds with a fork. Easily feeds a crowd.
watch: Serve with a GF BBQ sauce (no malt vinegar) and GF buns.

title: Picadillo (Ground Beef with Tomato and Olives)
description: Latin-style ground beef simmered with peppers, tomato sauce, cumin and bay leaves, salted with green olives. Spoon it over rice or into corn tortillas.
watch: Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Garlic Butter Pan-Seared Halibut
description: Spiced halibut fillets seared golden, then basted in garlic butter with lemon and rosemary. A 15-minute dinner that's elegant enough for a date night.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free butter (avoid almond/cashew-based brands) or olive oil.

title: Garlic Butter Baked Rainbow Trout
description: Rainbow trout baked in a foil packet with garlic and dill. Five ingredients, almost no cleanup.
swaps: Use a nut-free dairy-free butter (avoid almond/cashew-based brands) or olive oil.

title: Creamy Coconut Cod Curry
description: Flaky cod poached in a red curry coconut sauce with broccoli and carrots, served over rice with lime and green onion.
swaps: Use certified gluten-free tamari (or coconut aminos) in place of soy sauce. Use a shellfish-free curry paste (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many restaurant-style pastes contain shrimp paste.
watch: Chili crisp often contains soy sauce with wheat; check the label or skip it. Check broth/stock labels for wheat and dairy.

title: Sesame Cumin Tofu Bowls with Potato Crisps
description: Crispy tamari-glazed tofu with cumin and sesame over roasted sweet potato and baby gold potato 'crisps', drizzled with a garlicky lemon yogurt sauce.
swaps: Use a nut-free plant yogurt (soy or coconut, not almond/cashew) and an egg-free, nut-free vegan mayo.
watch: Use certified GF tamari.

title: Red Curry Vegetable Stir Fry with Seared Tofu
description: Seared tofu and a rainbow of vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, zucchini, snap peas, baby corn) simmered in a coconut red curry sauce.
swaps: Use a shellfish-free curry paste (e.g. Thai Kitchen); many restaurant-style pastes contain shrimp paste.

title: Sweet Potato Glass Noodles (Vegan Japchae)
description: Chewy sweet-potato starch noodles tossed with tofu, peppers, bok choy, carrots, mushrooms and spinach in a sesame-tamari sauce with a little gochugaru heat.
swaps: Use certified GF tamari (ignore the note suggesting regular soy sauce). Use a certified GF gochujang, or leave the 1 tsp chili paste out.
watch: Check that the noodles are 100% sweet potato starch.

title: General Tso's Tempeh
description: Crispy tapioca-dredged tempeh in a tangy-sweet General Tso's sauce of tamari, tomato paste, molasses, ginger and garlic, served with rice and broccoli.
swaps: Replace the 1 Tbsp peanut butter with sunflower seed butter.
watch: Use certified GF tamari; some tempeh is made with barley or wheat, so buy a soy-only tempeh.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Eggplant with Tahini Sauce
description: Roasted eggplant halves filled with quinoa, mushrooms, tomatoes and cumin, then drizzled with a lemony tahini sauce.
